Huntsman Center]] |champion= |tourney=[[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = Second Round }} {{2015–16 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2015–16 Utah Runnin' Utes men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Utah]] during the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They played their home games at the [[Jon M. Huntsman Center]] in [[Salt Lake City]] as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference men's basketball|Pac-12 Conference]]. The Utes were led by fifth year head coach [[Larry Krystkowiak]]. They the season 27–9, 13-5 in Pac-12 play to finish in second place. They defeated [[2015–16 USC Trojans men's basketball team|USC]] and [[2015–16 California Golden Bears men's basketball team|California]] to advance to the championship game of the [[2016 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] where they lost to [[2015–16 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team|Oregon]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2015–16 Fresno State Bulldogs men's basketball team|Fresno State]] in the first round to advance to the second round where they lost to [[2015–16 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]]. ==Previous season== The [[2014–15 Utah Utes men's basketball team|2014–15 Utah Utes]] finished the season 26–9, 13–5 in the Pac-12, to finish in a tie for second place. In the [[2015 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]], the Utes made it to the semifinals where they lost to Oregon. They received an at-large bid to the [[2015 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as a 5-seed where they defeated Stephen F. Austin in the second round, and Georgetown in the third round to advance to the Sweet Sixteen where they lost to Duke.{{cite web|title=Utah's Late-Game Rally Falls Short Against Duke|url=http://www.utahutes.com/sports/m-baskbl/recaps/032715aaa.html|website=UtahUtes.com|access-date=2015-06-05|archive-date=2015-05-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150522095556/http://www.utahutes.com/sports/m-baskbl/recaps/032715aaa.html|url-status=dead}} ==Off-season== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
